en: n. a small plant with sweet-smelling purple, blue or white flowers; a bluish-purple color; a. having a bluish-purple color
ex: She picked a bunch of violets in the garden.
她在花園裡摘了一束紫羅蘭。

en: n. a natural substance found in food that is necessary for good health
ex: Oranges are rich in vitamin C.
柳橙富含維生素 C。

en: a. (of a color or light) very bright and strong; producing clear and detailed pictures in the mind; (of a person) lively and imaginative
ex: She has vivid memories of her childhood in the countryside.
她對鄉下的童年有著鮮明的記憶。

en: n. an act of choosing someone or something by marking a paper or raising a hand; the total number of votes; the right to vote; vi. to make an official choice in an election; vt. to decide something by voting
ex: Every citizen over eighteen has the right to vote.
每位年滿十八歲的公民都有投票權。

en: n. money that is paid to a worker regularly, especially by the hour or week; a reward for something; vt. to carry on a war or campaign
ex: The factory workers asked for higher wages.
工廠工人要求更高的工資。

en: n. a strong vehicle with four wheels used for carrying heavy loads, often pulled by a horse; a railroad car for freight; a small cart for carrying things
ex: The farmer loaded the hay onto a wagon.
農夫把乾草裝上貨車。

en: n. a man (waiter) or woman (waitress) whose job is to serve customers food and drinks in a restaurant
ex: The waiter brought us the menu and a glass of water.
服務生給我們拿來菜單和一杯水。

en: n. a small flat case, usually made of leather, used to carry money, credit cards and other personal items
ex: He took some cash out of his wallet and paid the bill.
他從皮夾裡拿出一些現金付了帳。

en: vi. to walk slowly around a place without a clear purpose; to move away from the right path; to turn away from the main subject; vt. to walk through or around a place
ex: We wandered through the old streets of the city.
我們漫步穿過這座城市的老街。

en: vt. to tell someone about a possible danger or problem; to advise someone not to do something; vi. to give a warning
ex: The doctor warned him to stop smoking.
醫生警告他要戒菸。

en: vt. to clean something with water and soap; vi. to clean yourself or clothes; n. an act of washing; clothes that are being washed
ex: Please wash your hands before dinner.
晚餐前請洗手。

en: n. the use of something in a careless way; things that are thrown away; wild land that is not used; a. no longer needed or wanted; vt. to use something badly; to fail to take advantage of something
ex: It's a waste of time to argue with him.
跟他爭辯是浪費時間。

en: n. a place where water from a river falls from a high place to a lower place
ex: We hiked to a beautiful waterfall deep in the forest.
我們健行到森林深處一座美麗的瀑布。

en: a. having a lot of money, property or valuable possessions; (of a place) rich in resources
ex: He became a wealthy man after selling his company.
他賣掉公司後成了富翁。

en: n. an object such as a gun, knife or bomb that is used to hurt or kill someone; something used to gain an advantage in a conflict; vt. to supply with weapons
ex: The police found a hidden weapon in his car.
警方在他的車裡找到一把藏起來的武器。

en: vt. to marry someone; to join or combine two things; vi. to get married
ex: They plan to wed in the spring.
他們打算在春天結婚。

en: n. a ceremony in which two people are married; the act of getting married; a wedding anniversary; a combination of two things
ex: Over one hundred guests attended their wedding.
超過一百位賓客參加了他們的婚禮。

en: n. a wild plant growing where it is not wanted; vi. to remove weeds from a garden; vt. to remove unwanted plants or things
ex: He spent the afternoon pulling weeds in the garden.
他整個下午都在花園裡拔草。

en: n. any day of the week except Saturday and Sunday
ex: The office is open on weekdays from nine to five.
辦公室平日從九點開到五點。

en: vi. to cry quietly with tears falling from your eyes; to be very sad; vt. to shed tears for something; n. a period of crying
ex: She wept when she heard the sad news.
她聽到壞消息時哭了。

en: vt. to find out how heavy something is; to consider carefully before making a decision; to have a particular weight; vi. to have importance or influence; to be heavy
ex: The doctor weighed the baby on the scale.
醫生用磅秤替嬰兒量體重。

en: n. how heavy something is; a heavy object; importance or influence; a piece of metal used in exercise; vt. to make something heavier by adding something
ex: She has lost a lot of weight since last year.
她從去年到現在瘦了很多。

en: a. in or from the west part of a country or the world; relating to Europe and North America; n. a film or book about cowboys in the American West; a person from the west
ex: Many Western countries celebrate Christmas in December.
許多西方國家在十二月慶祝聖誕節。

en: n. a very large sea mammal that breathes through a hole on top of its head; vi. to hunt whales; vt. (informal) to hit someone very hard or defeat someone completely
ex: We went on a boat trip to watch whales.
我們搭船去賞鯨。

en: pron. anything or everything; no matter what; adv. at all; of any kind
ex: You can choose whatever you like from the menu.
你可以從菜單上選擇任何你喜歡的。

en: n. a round object that turns around to move a vehicle or machine; a device for steering a car or boat; vt. to push or pull something with wheels; vi. to turn around quickly
ex: The car's front wheel got stuck in the mud.
汽車的前輪卡在泥巴裡。

en: adv. in or to any place; at any place; used to emphasize surprise or ask where someone or something is
ex: I'll follow you wherever you go.
無論你去哪裡，我都會跟著你。

en: n. a long thin piece of leather or rope fixed to a handle, used for hitting people or animals; a member of Parliament who ensures party members vote; vt. to hit with a whip; to mix cream or eggs until they are thick; vi. to move quickly
ex: Whip the cream until it forms soft peaks.
把鮮奶油打到出現軟的尖角為止。

en: n. a high-pitched sound made by blowing through the lips; a small device that makes a loud sound when you blow it; vi. to make a high-pitched sound by blowing; vt. to produce a tune by whistling
ex: The referee blew his whistle to stop the game.
裁判吹哨暫停比賽。

en: pron. any person who; no matter who
ex: Whoever finds the lost wallet will get a reward.
無論誰找到遺失的皮夾都會得到獎賞。

en: a. morally bad and cruel; mischievous in a harmless way; (informal) excellent; (of a smell, weather or similar) very bad
ex: The wicked witch cast a spell on the princess.
邪惡的女巫對公主下了咒語。

en: n. the distance from one side of something to the other; the size of something from side to side; a wide range of things
ex: The table is two meters in length and one meter in width.
這張桌子長兩公尺，寬一公尺。

en: a. (of animals or plants) living in nature, not kept or grown by people; not controlled or calm; very excited or enthusiastic; n. a natural area that people have not changed
ex: We saw wild horses running across the plains.
我們看到野馬奔馳過平原。

en: a. with a lot of wind; (of a person) talking too much in a boring way; (informal) having gas in the stomach
ex: It was a cold and windy day in March.
那是三月一個又冷又多風的日子。

en: n. an alcoholic drink made from grapes or other fruit; a dark red color; v. to drink wine (usually in the phrase wine and dine)
ex: They ordered a bottle of red wine with dinner.
他們晚餐點了一瓶紅酒。

en: n. a long thin piece of metal that carries electricity or is used for fastening things; a telegram; a fence made of metal threads; vt. to fasten things using wire; to send a message by telegraph; vi. to send a telegram
ex: The electrician connected the wires to the switch.
電工把電線接到開關上。

en: prep. inside something; not further than a particular distance; before a period of time has passed; adv. inside; in the mind; n. the inside
ex: The package will arrive within three days.
包裹將在三天內送達。

en: n. a wild animal like a large dog that lives and hunts in groups; a cruel or greedy person; vt. to eat food very quickly and greedily
ex: A pack of wolves howled at the moon.
一群狼對著月亮嚎叫。
ph: keep the wolf from the door

en: n. the hard material from the stems of trees used for building or burning; (woods) a large area of land covered with trees; a group of trees
ex: We went for a walk in the woods behind the house.
我們在屋後的樹林裡散步。
ph: can't see the wood for the trees

en: n. the soft thick hair of sheep and some other animals; thread or cloth made from this hair
ex: She knitted a warm scarf from soft wool.
她用柔軟的羊毛織了一條保暖的圍巾。
ph: pull the wool over someone's eyes
